fn HasChordIntersection(n: Int, chords: List[List[Int]]) -> Bool
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires forall x in chords: forall x1 in x: (x1 >= 0)
  requires (n >= 2)
  requires (len(chords) == n)
  requires forall i in 0..len(chords): (((((len(chords[i]) == 2) and (chords[i][0] >= 1)) and (chords[i][0] <= (2 * n))) and (chords[i][1] >= 1)) and (chords[i][1] <= (2 * n)))
  requires forall i in 0..len(chords): forall j in 0..len(chords): forall k in 0..2: forall l in 0..2: ((not ((i != j) or (k != l))) or (chords[i][k] != chords[j][l]))
  ensures (result == (exists i in 0..len(chords): exists j in 0..len(chords): ((i != j) and (((((if (chords[i][0] < chords[i][1]) then chords[i][0] else chords[i][1]) < (if (chords[j][0] < chords[j][1]) then chords[j][0] else chords[j][1])) and ((if (chords[j][0] < chords[j][1]) then chords[j][0] else chords[j][1]) < (if (chords[i][0] > chords[i][1]) then chords[i][0] else chords[i][1]))) and ((if (chords[i][0] > chords[i][1]) then chords[i][0] else chords[i][1]) < (if (chords[j][0] > chords[j][1]) then chords[j][0] else chords[j][1]))) or ((((if (chords[j][0] < chords[j][1]) then chords[j][0] else chords[j][1]) < (if (chords[i][0] < chords[i][1]) then chords[i][0] else chords[i][1])) and ((if (chords[i][0] < chords[i][1]) then chords[i][0] else chords[i][1]) < (if (chords[j][0] > chords[j][1]) then chords[j][0] else chords[j][1]))) and ((if (chords[j][0] > chords[j][1]) then chords[j][0] else chords[j][1]) < (if (chords[i][0] > chords[i][1]) then chords[i][0] else chords[i][1])))))))
  effects pure
  example (HasChordIntersection(0, []) == true)
{
  true
}
